questions.learningObjective: Solve a quantitative lorentz transformations problem by applying the governing physical principle.
questions.stem: At t = 11.0 seconds an event sits at x = 4.00 × 10^8 meters in S, while S' moves at 0.579c. Find t'.

options.misconception: Omits the Lorentz factor gamma
Uses a plus sign in the Lorentz transformation
Reports the untransformed coordinate time

questions.explanation: The Lorentz time transformation is t' = gamma times (t minus v x/c^2) = gamma times (t minus beta x/c). With gamma = 1.227 this gives 1.25 × 10^1 seconds. Dropping gamma or flipping the sign inside the parentheses are classic errors, and quoting t ignores the transformation altogether.
questions.hint: Apply t' = gamma times (t minus v x over c squared).
